slides.title: Documentation
slides.body:
Describes what already exists.
If it's wrong,
you're *misinformed*.

slides.title: An allocation system
slides.body:
Decides what happens next.
If it's wrong, two people
get the *same subnet*.

slides.title: What most estates run
slides.body:
A spreadsheet.
An allocation system
with *no locking*.

slides.title: Tuesday
slides.body:
Two engineers open the file.
Both need a /24
for a new site.

slides.title: Both
slides.body:
Scroll to the first block
that *looks* free.
Both take it.

slides.title: The save
slides.body:
One saves. Then the other.
The second save wins
*silently*.

slides.title: Nobody was careless
slides.body:
The tool has no concept
of two people asking
*at once*.

slides.title: Weeks later
steps: The first hour goes on proving the addressing is *fine*.

slides.title:
You don't need
better discipline.
slides.body:
You need the careless path
to be *unavailable*.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
